messages:
sara-ops: Heads-up — customer tenant-57 reports ~4k fewer audit events in their SIEM since 2024-11-03 03:00 UTC. S3 manifests show uploads succeeded. Anyone seeing a delivery vs index mismatch?

mike-security: looking into it. Can you paste the manifest key and any forwarder IDs? @josh-infra FYI.

sara-ops: manifest: s3://redwood-audit/tenant-57/2024-11-03/manifest-03T03:00Z.json.gz. Upload logs show 200 OK and md5 matches. Forwarder id fwd-9b2.

josh-infra: quick check of forwarder and ES side — forwarder acked to kafka at 2024-11-03T03:00:15Z. ES bulk API returned 200 for most batches, but we had a 504 spike around 03:02. Snippet:
```
2024-11-03T03:02:21Z ERROR es_bulk_handler: bulk request timeout 504 retrying
2024-11-03T03:02:22Z INFO es_bulk_handler: retry 1
```

anna-support: customer says they're specifically missing `policy.create` and `session.end` events from that window — they're using those for retention auditing.

mike-security: couple things to correlate: ES index rollover/merge jobs and a tenant KMS rekey job started ~02:58 — re-encrypt tasks can create decrypt/encrypt load. audit-bot: any KMS jobs recorded?

audit-bot: detected KMS-key-rotate job for tenant-57 at 2024-11-03T02:58:40Z, status: in-progress, affected shards: 3.

sara-ops: I tried a local replay of the same manifest against staging and forwarder shows delivery but SIEM still didn't index some docs. Repro steps I used below.

josh-infra: repro notes from infra: run `./tools/replay_manifest.sh --manifest <url> --target es-staging` and tail forwarder logs. When KMS rekey/reencrypt runs concurrently we see KMS throttling and upload backlog: 
```
WARN decryptor: KMS throttling: 429
WARN uploader: backlog queue length 312
INFO forwarder: manifest completed, marking as processed
```
That last line is suspicious — manifest marked complete while items still in backlog.

mike-security: hypothesis: KMS rekey job caused temporary HSM/KMS throttling; forwarder switched to async completion path and marked manifest done before all docs were fully indexed. That would explain delivery ack vs missing events in ES/SIEM.

anna-support: mitigation for customer while we fix: run a targeted replay for the tenant with re-encrypt and force-manifest-pending to ensure we wait for ES ack. Can you post the exact commands?

sara-ops: copy of steps I'm going to run for tenant-57:
```
1) aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/tenant-57/2024-11-03/manifest-03T03:00Z.json.gz ./manifest.json.gz
2) ./tools/replay_manifest.sh --manifest ./manifest.json.gz --reencrypt --max-concurrency 8 --force-pending
3) monitor forwarder backlog via /ops/forwarder/backlog and ES via `curl -s $ES/_cat/indices?v`
4) confirm doc count delta for tenant-57 matches expected from manifest totals
```

mike-security: I'll open a short-lived alert and PR: alarm if manifest marked complete but `es_docs_indexed < manifest_expected` for 10m. Also adding a guard in forwarder to stall completion if KMS errors exceed threshold.

deploy-bot: Started job #3421 to rollout forwarder backpressure guard to canary (canary group: fwd-9a,fwd-9b,fwd-9c).

sara-ops: running the replay now for tenant-57. Will post before/after counts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
